howto_steps.name: Screen the deal against the life box
howto_steps.text: Confirm stabilized occupancy, primary or strong secondary market, roughly 55–65% LTV, 1.25x–1.40x in-place DSCR, and loan size generally $5M+ ($10M+ most competitive).

howto_steps.name: Assemble the submission package
howto_steps.text: Prepare OM or summary, T12 and rent roll, sponsor resume and PFS, schedule of real estate owned, and a clear hold/refinance thesis.

howto_steps.name: Submit through a life-company correspondent
howto_steps.text: Life companies do not take retail applications. CLS CRE routes the package to desks with open allocation for the asset type, market, and size.

howto_steps.name: Negotiate term sheet and third parties
howto_steps.text: Compare spread, IO, reserves, assumption language, and yield-maintenance schedule; order appraisal and required third-party reports.

howto_steps.name: Underwrite and close
howto_steps.text: Typical life company permanent closings run about 60–90 days from a complete package, depending on third parties and sponsor responsiveness.
